requirements_summary: Use-case: enterprise RAG for clinician search + decision support. Index scale target: ingest 15-25M clinical note chunks (~3M patients). Query profile: physician-facing, p95 latency target <250ms, P50 <120ms for single-turn retrieval+rerank; expected peak QPS 300-600 (scheduled clinic hours). Cost sensitivity: target amortized cost per search < $0.003 (embeddings + reranker). Models: prefer open biomedical encoders (BioSentBERT/SBERT variants) for embeddings; cross-encoder reranker fine-tuned on clinical relevance. Routing: fallbacks to smaller quantized models during load. PHI constraints: no plaintext PHI to hosted control plane, require VPC peering/private control plane or on-prem, KMS/HSM for key management, and end-to-end audit logs with user-level access trail.
